listing.name: Diamond Legacy (EN Translation)
listing.summary: A CN translation and adjustment of Diamond Chip's: Diamond Legacy. This version is a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack. It was originally a bounty pack, was unable to effectively translate the Magiclib Bounty Data so it exists in this form as a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large pack of superships for pirates and other factions, along with hullmods that offer powerful but risky bonuses.

description: This translation and adjustment of Diamond Legacy introduces numerous ships to the pirate faction, with additional lore-friendly and non-lore additions for the Luddic Path, Persean League, and Hegemony. It includes dmods available at zero deployment points on the refit screen, which provide significant advantages alongside major drawbacks. The mod is described as very unbalanced.
